name: CSO_CONTENT
description: This table contains the master record for all localized versions of a content record. Each content record can have multiple versions for any number of different locales.

columns.name: CONTENT_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content channel record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: Datetime the record was added to repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime the record was modified in the repository.

columns.name: DISPLAY_END_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the content record is no longer valid to be displayed.

columns.name: DISPLAY_START_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the content record is eligible to be displayed.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: The locale associated with the current record.

columns.name: PARENT_CONTENT_ID
columns.description: If the content record has a relationship to another record.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: ROOT_SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to the repository that owns the content record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: The obsolete GUID of the creator of the record.

columns.name: EVENT_START_DATE
columns.description: If the content belongs to a channel defined as an event channel, contains the start datetime of the event.

columns.name: EVENT_END_DATE
columns.description: The end datetime of the event (event channels only)

columns.name: QUERY_ID
columns.description: This column has been deprecated and is not used right now.

columns.name: MODERATED
columns.description: If the content record belongs to a threaded discussion, determines if the content must be moderated before it is published.

columns.name: CHANGES_PENDING
columns.description: flag indicating if there are any pending content changes.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized username for the original creator of the content record.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: document id for the content record.

columns.name: ALIAS_ID
columns.description: points to the content GUID of the aliased record to this record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The ID of the creator of the record.
